recommendation: obtain written, scope-specific approval before payload access; use encrypted local-only custody, checksum manifests, retention/deletion receipts, and redacted validation evidence

options.recommended: written licence/DUA and scope approval, followed by local-only acquisition with no committed terms
options.lower_risk: metadata-only reachability/status/schema probe without retaining concept, label, or full response content
options.not_recommended: broad redistribution or derived mapping approval before source-specific rights and privacy review

contingencies.terms_unclear: remain no_go_pending_license and seek licensor clarification
contingencies.scope_changes_or_expiry: quarantine or delete local cache and transition to expired_or_revoked
contingencies.approval_denied: retain metadata-only governance and do not infer or reconstruct restricted terms

panel_role: advisory evidence review and conflict analysis only; cannot grant rights or approve redistribution
accountability_gate: named licence holder, DAC, affiliate, maintainer, or delegated authority must approve scope and date

LOINC.recommendation: local-only metadata probe after account/licence acceptance; no labels, long names, parts, derived rows, or redistribution

SNOMED_CT.recommendation: written affiliate/member agreement first; split approval by edition/extension/map; no payload or crosswalk promotion

UMLS.recommendation: written NLM terms and per-source-vocabulary rights matrix; exclude restricted SABs; local-only cache

OMIM.recommendation: metadata-only until registration/API terms approval; secrets only in environment/secret store; no clinical synopses/genemap/morbidmap

DECIPHER.recommendation: metadata-only until DAC/DUA/privacy approval; no patient, variant, phenotype, syndrome, or gene-review rows; no LLM transfer

MedDRA.recommendation: retain archived no-go unless subscription, language pack, local custody, and regulatory-semantics approval are documented
